remarks: Situated in the desirable community of Alces in South Edmonton, this beautifully crafted home offers an exceptional blend of space, style, and functionality. Custom finishes, elegant feature walls, and quality cabinetry add sophistication throughout. Upstairs, four generously sized bedrooms, three full bathrooms, and a spacious bonus room provide plenty of room for family, guests, and relaxation. The luxurious primary suite serves as a private retreat, offering comfort & convenience.
